about: The art kit (OP-229): seamless textures and keyed shape sheets the level assembler (OP-234) builds screens from. Texture keys are kit-tex-<name>, 512 x 512, tileable. A sheet key is kit-sheet-<name>: one 2048 x 1152 painting on the key colour, six props in a grid of three across and two down, cut by `art:finish pieces` into the pieces listed here in reading order, each shipped as kit-<piece> at its logical size (w x h, 1x and 2x) with its alpha. tools/art/README.md describes the format. An area set is kit.areas.<area>: its accent textures (kit-tex-<area>-<name>), its prop sheets (kit-sheet-<area>-<name>, cut to kit-<area>-<piece>) and its seven backdrop layers (kit-<area>-sky-a|b 1600 x 900 opaque, kit-<area>-far-a|b 1600 x 900 keyed, kit-<area>-mid-a|b|c 800 x 450 keyed), every one repeating sideways so the assembler can run it along any screen.
palette: bark #2B1C12 to #4A3322, inner wood #5C4632 to #8F8068, moss #3E5A3A and #6E8B4E, leaf #4F7A3E and #8DAE5A, lantern gold #C9A227 and #FFD36A, cream #F6F1E3, navy #0C1E36 to #07122A, dusk blue #2E4C7A, sky blue #6F9BC8

layers.sky-b: the open night sky above the canopy with no moon, deep navy to dusk blue at the bottom, scattered stars and a bank of soft rounded clouds low along the bottom third lit cream from above

pieces.name: log-bridge
pieces.desc: a fallen log lying level as a bridge, moss on top, cut straight at both ends so it repeats

pieces.name: vine-curtain
pieces.desc: a curtain of hanging vines with small leaves, from a branch above

pieces.name: beehive-lantern
pieces.desc: a round straw beehive hanging from a hook, glowing warm amber from its door

pieces.name: leaf-platform
pieces.desc: a wide flat cluster of large leaves to stand on, layered, cut straight at both ends

pieces.name: acorn-cap
pieces.desc: a giant acorn cap lying open side down, a small round platform

pieces.name: bough-end-perch
pieces.desc: the leafy end of a bough with a flat perch on top

pieces.name: cocoon-bare
pieces.desc: a pale silk cocoon hanging from a thread, closed, nothing drawn on it

pieces.name: feather-lost
pieces.desc: a single large cream and brown owl feather standing upright, glowing faintly

pieces.name: finish-shrine
pieces.desc: a small shrine of inner wood with a round arch, a bare plinth inside and two lanterns, nothing on the plinth

layers.sky-a: a canopy of thick leaves seen from below, filling the frame, amber light breaking through many small gaps and a few shafts of it
layers.sky-b: warm late sky in amber and dusk blue over open treetops, soft clouds lit from below, no sun drawn
layers.far-a: the lower boughs of great neighbouring trees stretching across, with small treehouse huts and lantern points among them, filling the middle band and fading at the top and the bottom
layers.far-b: a forest floor of ferns and moss far below seen from above, a stream of light through it, filling the lower two thirds and fading at the top
layers.mid-a: thick lower boughs with leaf clusters in two greens, rope bridges and a hut or two, lantern strings between them, in the lower two thirds, the upper third mostly open
layers.mid-b: the inside of a hollow trunk: curved walls of worn wood with knotholes letting amber light in, hanging roots and a few shelf fungi, filling the whole frame
layers.mid-c: open treetops in warm light with drifts of amber leaves rising on an updraft, the crowns of trees in the lower half, the upper half mostly open

glass.title: the stained-glass realm: its Commons high in cool haze, and the glass tower course
glass.light: cool cream moonlight high up in clear blue-navy air with a light mist, the dusk blue #6F9BC8 of the height, and jewel colours only where stained glass is lit from within: gold #C9A227, ruby #A3202F, emerald #1E6B4C, sapphire #1F4A9C and amber #E6A530 in panes between dark navy lead lines

textures.glass-panes: leaded stained glass seen flat on: small panes of deep lapis, violet, gold, ruby, emerald and sapphire in abstract leaf and feather shapes between dark navy lead lines, a few panes lit brighter
textures.pale-stone: fitted pale stone blocks with cool blue shadows in the joints, smooth and even, the stone of a high tower
textures.lead-lattice: a dark lead lattice of small diamond panes, most of them pale frosted glass, a few lit mint and lilac

pieces.name: idol-pedestal
pieces.desc: a round pedestal of pale stone with a ring of stained glass inlay glowing gold around its top, nothing standing on it

pieces.name: glass-lantern
pieces.desc: a tall hanging lantern of stained glass panes in gold and ruby on a dark iron chain, glowing from within

pieces.name: stone-bench
pieces.desc: a pale stone bench with a back panel of lit stained glass in sapphire and emerald

pieces.name: rose-window
pieces.desc: a round rose window of stained glass in a pale stone frame, lit from within, standing on its own

pieces.name: glass-planter
pieces.desc: a pale stone planter holding flowers made of coloured glass on thin lead stems

pieces.name: kiosk
pieces.desc: a small kiosk of pale stone with a stained-glass awning in gold and amber and a bare counter, no writing

pieces.name: lift-car
pieces.desc: a glass lift car: a tall cage of dark lead and clear and lapis glass panes with a brass floor, hanging from a cable above

pieces.name: lift-rail
pieces.desc: a straight vertical rail of dark lead and brass with small lit panes along it, cut straight at both ends so it repeats upward

pieces.name: window-arch
pieces.desc: a tall pointed arch window of stained glass in a pale stone frame, lit sapphire and gold, standing on its own

pieces.name: buttress
pieces.desc: a flying buttress of pale stone leaning left, its underside carved, cut straight at the top

pieces.name: glass-bridge
pieces.desc: a level bridge of thick pale glass slabs on a dark lead frame, flat on top, cut straight at both ends so it repeats

pieces.name: finial
pieces.desc: a tall spire finial of dark lead and gold glass, pointed, to top a tower

pieces.name: door-glass-closed
pieces.desc: a tall pointed door of stained glass in a pale stone frame, shut, dim

pieces.name: door-glass-open
pieces.desc: the same tall pointed doorway open, warm gold light inside

pieces.name: chandelier
pieces.desc: a chandelier of hanging stained-glass drops in gold and ruby on a dark iron ring, on a chain from above

pieces.name: feather-lost
pieces.desc: a single large owl feather made of pale glass, standing upright, glowing faintly cream

pieces.name: finish-shrine
pieces.desc: a small shrine of pale stone with a pointed arch of stained glass, a bare plinth inside and two glass lanterns, nothing on the plinth

pieces.name: weathervane
pieces.desc: a dark iron weathervane on a short pale stone cap, its arrow a feather shape, no letters

layers.sky-a: a high clear night sky in blue-navy with many small stars, a light mist along the bottom third, no moon drawn
layers.sky-b: a high hazy night sky in dusk blue with thin streaks of pale cloud level with the viewer, stars above them, no moon drawn
layers.far-a: the spires and mosaic towers of a glass city far below, their stained glass lit in jewel colours, rising out of a sea of soft cloud, filling the lower two thirds and fading at the top
layers.far-b: a sea of soft moonlit cloud far below with a few glass spire tips showing through, filling the lower half and fading at the top
layers.mid-a: the wall of a glass tower close by: tall leaded panes of lapis and violet with a few lit gold and rose, pale stone mullions between them, filling the whole frame
layers.mid-b: pale stone arches and buttresses of a high tower with stained-glass windows lit from within and glass lanterns hanging between them, in the lower two thirds, the upper third mostly open
layers.mid-c: a row of balconies and rose windows along a tower's side, glass lanterns on chains, the mist drifting past below them, in the lower half, the upper half mostly open
